item.title: Two presidential campaign staffers killed in Colombia as elections near
item.description: Rights office says the violence could hinder 'exercise of political rights' ahead of May vote to replace Gustavo Petro.

item.title: Al Jazeera’s exclusive report from the Strait of Hormuz

item.title: Hamas confirms killing of Qassam Brigades leader in Israeli attack
item.description: Israel targeted Izz al-Din al-Haddad, the head of Hamas's armed wing in Gaza, in an attack that killed seven others.

item.title: Abu-Bilal al-Minuki: ISIL’s shadow commander in West Africa
item.description: Nigeria and the US say 'key' ISIL leader was killed in joint military operation in Borno state.

item.title: Iran warns of readiness for war and economic costs as US talks falter
item.description: Iranian leaders and TV have ramped up pressure on the US with a stream of messaging to domestic and foreign audiences.

item.title: Israeli army kills Palestinian man, raids homes in occupied West Bank
item.description: Israeli forces killed a 34-year-old man in Jenin Camp, the Palestinian health ministry said.

item.description: President Donald Trump said the operation eliminated "the most active terrorist in the world", Abu-Bilal al-Minuki.

item.title: Lebanon says six killed in Israeli strike as US announces ceasefire extension
item.description: President Trump announced the truce last month, but Israel and Hezbollah have continued to exchange fire since then.

item.title: Man killed by 13ft shark in Western Australia
item.description: The attack occurred at Horseshoe Reef - north-west of the popular Rottnest Island near the city of Perth, local police say.

item.title: Why is Ireland not taking part in this year's Eurovision?
item.description: Ireland's boycott is the latest in a series of moves that has seen the country at odds with Israel over its war in Gaza.
